Distinct encoder/decoder paths, no output feeding own generating step. Blank token squares, state rectangles, context bridge, blank embedding feedback modules; avoid only a minimal block overview. Reserve label positions above respective path and adjacent blank tokens. Scientific topology important. Independent original layout.
